items.issue: `docket.py unpublished` silently skips kept entries whose `Path(transcript).parent / "memory"` does not resolve to `--store` (docket.py:205). The PRD never specifies this filter. An entry whose transcript sits elsewhere is never listed, so the check can return a false empty (exit 0) for a store the user passes. The PRD says "never a false empty result".
items.reason: deferred by review-close: settled design decision (per-entry store routing, one distil run spans several stores)

items.issue: `unpublished` has an unrequested "only the last kept entry for a target owns it" rule (docket.py:193-212). An earlier kept entry that is unpublished but shares a target stem with a later one is hidden. The spec lists "kept entries whose intended target content or pointer is missing/mismatched" and does not mention this rule.
items.reason: deferred by review-close: settled design decision (one owner per target stem so a re-publish never reverts a newer memory)

items.issue: `decide <id> kept` on an already-kept entry with neither `--file` nor `--name` raises `no-undecided-entry` (docket.py:154-157). The PRD says re-deciding the same state is allowed. SKILL.md:214 documents the refusal, so the code and doc agree, but both are narrower than the spec text.
items.reason: deferred by review-close: settled design decision (a recovery edit needs --file)
